summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved watchlists not persisting across login  ### What I found by reading the code (no changes made) - `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` — every route requires a valid session, resolves `user_id` from the session cookie/token, and every query (`GET /`, `GET /:id`, item add/remove) filters strictly by `eq(watchlists.user_id, userId)`. No anonymous or local fallback exists in this module. - `db/auth.ts` — `login()` looks up the existing user row and always reuses that user's stable DB `id`; each login just creates a *new session token* pointing at the *same* `user_id`.
